title: UTCS Jurisdiction Breakdown
description: A single taxing authority's levy on a line item. Part of the canonical Tax Result output.

jurisdiction_code.description: Standardized jurisdiction identifier. Interpreted according to jurisdiction_code_system.

jurisdiction_code_system.description: Code system that jurisdiction_code is drawn from, so the identifier is unambiguous across regions. UTCS ships no jurisdiction codes itself; the provider names the system it used. The us-sst conformance profile REQUIRES 'fips'.

tax_type.description: Type of tax levied. Provider-derived OUTPUT determined from origin, destination, entity type, date, and nexus. Never supplied by the caller. Maps to the UBL cac:TaxScheme/cbc:ID (UNCL5153) when emitting e-invoices.

tax_category.description: Taxability treatment of the levy, expressed as a UN/EDIFACT 5305 (UNCL5305) duty/tax/fee category code. Provider-derived OUTPUT. Maps directly to UBL cac:TaxCategory/cbc:ID for e-invoicing and expresses the same concept as an SST taxability treatment. S=standard rate, Z=zero rated, E=exempt, AE=VAT reverse charge, K=intra-community supply (EEA), G=free export item (tax not charged), O=outside scope of tax, L=Canary Islands indirect tax, M=Ceuta and Melilla tax, B=transferred VAT (Italy).

fee_basis.description: How this levy is computed, so a consumer can reconcile tax_amount without inferring a rate. 'ad_valorem' (default): tax_amount equals taxable_amount multiplied by rate. 'flat': a fixed statutory amount per transaction or delivery, independent of order value (for example, Colorado's retail delivery fee); rate does not apply. 'per_unit': a fixed amount per unit, where tax_amount equals unit_rate multiplied by units (for example, per-tire, per-battery, or per-container environmental fees).

rate.description: Tax rate applied as a decimal string (e.g., "0.065" for 6.5%). Applies to the ad_valorem fee basis and is omitted for flat and per_unit levies.

unit_rate.description: Fee charged per unit, as a decimal string. Present for the per_unit fee basis, where tax_amount equals unit_rate multiplied by units.

units.description: Count of units the per_unit fee applies to, as a decimal string (fractional units are allowed for weight- or volume-based fees). Present for the per_unit fee basis.

taxable_amount.description: Amount subject to this jurisdiction's tax.

tax_amount.description: Levy calculated by this jurisdiction. Its derivation depends on fee_basis: taxable_amount multiplied by rate for ad_valorem, the fixed statutory amount for flat, or unit_rate multiplied by units for per_unit.

rate_rule_id.description: Provider's identifier for the specific rate rule applied. Enables audit tracing.

oneOf.description: Exemption that reduced tax for this jurisdiction.

certificate_id.description: Identifier of the exemption certificate applied.

exemption_reason.description: Controlled reason the exemption was granted. Aligned to the SSTGB Uniform Sales and Use Tax Exemption/Resale Certificate (Form F0003) reason categories. Conformance profiles MAY narrow this list.

exemption_type.description: Optional provider-specific refinement of exemption_reason (free text). Present for finer detail beyond the controlled vocabulary.

exemption_applied.description: If an exemption reduced tax, includes certificate ID and exemption type. Null if no exemption applied.

allOf.$comment: rate is required for ad_valorem levies (the default when fee_basis is absent) and omitted for flat and per_unit.
per_unit levies carry the per-unit amount and unit count in place of a rate.
